text: sed -n 5,14p CHANGELOG.md; echo "   ..."; sed -n 78,92p CHANGELOG.md: iffer, but it was reachable only from the proven-alias disjunct. On a may-alias summary with a fresh checked-arithmetic box the caller had to choose, at compile time, between leaking once per call and freeing twice — and that choice is only forced when the release must be decided statically. Where both operands are boxed, and therefore comparable as single pointers, the runtime can decide and neither horn has to be taken; that path now reaches the conditional release too, gated on comparability, and where the payloads are not comparable nothing changes. `fib` sits exactly there: its summary is `Unknown` because the body calls itself. Measured rather than assumed, since a functional test cannot see a leak — 2000 calls through this path report `allocs=19992 frees=19992` under `--gc-stats`, `examples/fibonacci` is now identical to reference PHP, and the 272 runtime-GC regression tests pass.
